messages.author: 91fcdff1323a6831
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Python help
parts:
I think there's no reason not to ask the d-rug list! Have at it. However, I do think there are some folks who are really savvy with python over at DIB (Data Intensive Biology). They run a Meet and Analyze Data (MAD) session during the year, and there are some Python experts that are usually in attendance. Taylor may be able to provide some more details, but that would be the group I'd seek out for Python advice.

dib-tr...@lists.idyll.org
http://lists.idyll.org/listinfo/dib-training

Adios,
R
